landing.badge: YO FHAṰELWA YA BILLION I TEVHELAHO
landing.feat1Desc: Thendelano dza vhuṱali dzi kombetshedza mulayo muṅwe na muṅwe. Ahuna mudzudzanyi ane a nga shavha na dzivha. Muṋeelo muṅwe na muṅwe wo khwaṱhisedzwaho kha tshene.
landing.feat1Title: A sa fulufhedzei & a vha khagala
landing.feat2Desc: Munwe na munwe ane avha na tshipatshi tsha Stellar. Ahuna akhaunthu ya bannga. Ahuna tsheke ya tshikolodo. Ahuna mikano.
landing.feat3Desc: Fhaṱani MoiScore yaṋu nga muṋeelo muṅwe na muṅwe wa tshifhinga. Vhuḓiṱalusi ha zwa masheleni vhu hwaleaho.
landing.feat4Desc: Mikovhe ya stellar ya sub-cent i ita uri zwidiko zwa ḓuvha ḽiṅwe na ḽiṅwe zwi shume. Ahuna mbadelo dza platform dza u sika kana u dzhena.
landing.feat5Desc: Random, yo dzudzanyeaho, fandisi, kana vouthu. Tshiṱiriki tshaṋu, milayo yaṋu.
landing.feat6Desc: USDC namusi. Dzi stablecoin nnzhi kha mbekanyamushumo ya nḓila.
landing.heroDesc: Zwiṱirathedzhi zwa u vhulunga zwo fhandekanywaho kha Stellar. Zero vha vhukati. Vhuvhusi ha masheleni ha 1.3 biḽioni vha si na bannga.
landing.readyDesc: Kha vha ite tshiṱirathedzhi tshavho tsha u thoma tsha u vhulunga nga fhasi ha mimunithi mivhili.
